bulk.title: Bulk SN Operations
bulk.subtitle: Choose the warehouse operation first. Stock condition and inventory effects are controlled by that workflow.
bulk.modeHelp.NEW_INBOUND: Receive new physical stock and create the supplied serial identities in one batch.
bulk.modeHelp.FAULTY_RECEIVING: Validate faulty units independently and receive valid rows into the Repair workflow.
bulk.modeHelp.LEGACY_REPAIR_GOOD: Controlled legacy recognition only; tracked RepairJobs must use normal completion.
bulk.modeHelp.OUTBOUND: Open an active SH and manage each serial-tracked line independently.
bulk.modeHelp.BIND_EXISTING: Create serial identities against existing Physical Qty without increasing stock.
bulk.outboundHelp: Each outbound line keeps its own required condition, required quantity and assigned serial count.
